title: R Draconis — a pulsating giant star
plain_result: 1635 SPHEREx pictures over 2 visits. None of the 2180 remaining changes were matched to the star itself — likely because a star this bright saturates SPHEREx's detector at its centre, where pixels are excluded (not yet checked for this field). A light curve (one brightness per picture after removing the star's colour) is not measured yet.
method_note: Counts use the frozen change model (revision 2). A variable star should keep showing up after correction; a still star should not.
